Q1 (a) Explain  about  the planning  feature  of Lothal. Why  was Lothal an  important  city  during
Harappan Civilization?
[2]

the planning aspects of the two.
[3]


Q2 (a) Explain in detail about the architectural features of Sanchi Stupa, M.P. [2]

Chaitya Hall at Karle, Maharashtra.
[3]

Temple Architecture in India.
[2]
Q3 (b) Explain  about  the Vesara Style of  Temple  architecture  in  India. Explain  about  the
significance  of Pancharathas  by Pallavas as  a  prototype  model  for  future South Indian
Temples.
[3]


Q4 (a) Explain  about  the  salient architectural features  of Chalukyan Group  of  Temples,
Karnataka.
[2]
Q4 (b) Explain in detail about the architectural features of a Temple in India by Rashtrakutas. [3]


Q5 (a) Explain about the difference between Nagara Style and Dravidian Style Temples. [2]
Q5 (b) Explain  the  salient  Architectural  features  of  Kalinga  Temple  Style  with reference  to
Lingaraja Temple, Bhubaneshwar.
[3]
